item.description:
I am currently a PhD candidate at Trusted Systems Group under the supervision of Sven Bugiel at CISPA. I work on capability systems, with a focus on improving their adaptability and accelerating program migration through automation.

Previously, I completed my master’s in the Erasmus Mundus Cyberus Joint Master program, specializing in the IoT Security track. My thesis at IMDEA Software Institute named Enhancing System Security Through Static Analysis by Detecting Dormant Vulnerabilities focuses on identifying unreachable vulnerabilities in Debian-based systems to enable more effective vulnerability prioritization.

My interest in security began during my undergraduate studies at Sabancı University, where I worked on detecting timing-based side-channel attacks for my bachelor’s thesis.
